explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step and is always on at D2, where the value depends on the choice and the state reached: chose a2 and reached S2 gives 9-10 (10 when the previous trial was unrewarded, 9 during a run of rewarded trials), chose a1 and reached S2 by a rare transition gives 9, chose a2 and reached S1 by a rare transition gives 8, and chose a1 and reached S1 gives 8 (or 7 during a long run of rewarded trials). Time in the episode does not matter.
